universal_lens: Phase 5 constructs a unified Sports Intelligence OS by mapping adversarial state spaces, programmable DSL query manifolds, and cross-sport correlation tensors into a single isomorphic framework. This structural unification treats real-time war room overlays as continuous projections of high-dimensional latent market dynamics.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the programmable DSL and cross-sport correlation engine to Bayesian hierarchical models and conformal inference sets. reasoning_traces.think:
The Phase 5 architecture fundamentally shifts the Galaxy platform from a static consumer interface to a dynamic, programmable intelligence operating system. Mathematically, this transition is modeled as the construction of a high-dimensional vector space where each primitive—DSL, Anti-Galaxy, Correlation Engine—represents an orthogonal basis vector. The Programmable DSL acts as a syntactic layer allowing users to define arbitrary linear combinations of these basis vectors, effectively creating custom observables. The Anti-Galaxy model introduces a dual space, representing the strategy set of an optimal adversary. By continuously solving for the Nash equilibrium between the primary intelligence model and this adversarial proxy, the system derives robust, minimax-optimal predictions. The Cross-Sport Correlation Engine extends this by computing tensor products across distinct domain manifolds (e.g., basketball vs. soccer), identifying latent isomorphisms in player fatigue or market inefficiency. The Live War Room serves as the real-time projection operator, mapping these complex, high-dimensional state vectors onto a 2D visualizable plane via WebSocket streams. Failure modes arise if the underlying assumptions of stationarity break; for instance, if rule changes alter the fundamental topology of a sport's state space, the correlation kernels must be re-estimated. The B2B API essentially exports these solved state vectors, enforcing strict compliance boundaries that act as convex constraints on the exported decision variables.
